body:
A living mid-century gouache travel-poster painting of Mount Fuji behind a five-storey Japanese pagoda, static locked-off camera, seamless looping animation. The pagoda is vermilion-orange with deep teal-slate tiled roofs, a slender spire, and a dark evergreen tree beside it. Fuji sits small and distant in dusty blue-grey with a snow-white cap and ragged dry-brush ridges, over a pale mist field. Foreground cherry trees in soft coral-pink blossom with dark trunks frame the bottom, and tiny figures stand on pale speckled ground. Warm cream paper-grain sky fills the upper half. Matte flat gouache with ragged, flaking edges, visible bristle marks and speckled holes. Subtle motion only: blossom petals drift down, branches sway faintly, tiny figures shift, a bell-like gentle shimmer on the light. Soft spring morning light, vertical 3:4, perfect loop.

Production adaptation: The text above defines the visual idea and action. For this call output only ONE PNG SPRITE SHEET, NOT a GIF file: exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal portrait 3:4 cells, chronological row-major order. No border, grid lines, gutters, frame numbers, timestamps, or extra text. Fixed camera and ground line unless the action explicitly moves the camera. Keep scale, character identity, palette and geometry consistent; each cell is one distinctly different consecutive animation pose with nothing crossing cell boundaries. Cells will be extracted and encoded locally afterward. Make the motion return naturally from the final cell to the first.

en.body:
## How to use

Use the complete adapted prompt without a reference image.

Generate one PNG sheet, extract 8 cells in row-major order, and encode them with the recorded delays and loop setting. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

8 frames, 2 seconds, 360×480px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Eight gouache frames show falling cherry petals and subtle visitor motion around the pagoda and Fuji. 3:4 center crop; two-second repeating GIF. Mild building and landscape drift across redrawn frames remains and must be described as an adaptation limitation.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@devteamdrew's original prompt](https://x.com/devteamdrew/status/2118538745175503130). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.

## 使用方法

使用完整改编词，无需参考图。

先生成单张 PNG 精灵图，按行优先提取 8 格，以记录的停留时长和循环设置编码为 GIF。生图工具返回静态 PNG；GIF 由本地合成。原精灵图、裁切坐标、逐帧时长与首帧封面均保存在批次档案。

## 结果与限制

8 帧，2 秒，360×480 像素，无限循环；GPT Image 精灵图逐格裁切并在本地编码为 GIF。

逐格中心裁为 3:4；水面和云层变化可见，景物有轻微重绘漂移。

## 来源

由 Prompt Seen 根据 [@devteamdrew 的原词](https://x.com/devteamdrew/status/2118538745175503130)改编。来源作者称原作品使用 Image 2.6；本次仅确认 GPT Image 家族，精确型号未知。中英文页面保留同一实际提交正文。点赞属于整篇来源帖，同帖变体共享统计对象，不属于本站新作品。
